title: 第十章 我不和你比贱！

content_zh:
然后他才绕了一圈，从外面回来。
却没有想到一回来就看见两个人站在紫竹园门前。而且其中一人居然还在出言不逊，辱及自己师傅！不由怒火上涌，冷冷反击。
这家伙一报名，他就知道，这正是锁云峰峰主李劲松的独生儿子。所以楚阳反击也是拿捏着分寸，你骂我的师父，我就用你父亲还击！
不管前世今生，楚阳都是不肯吃亏的。
“你是谁？”白衣少年李剑吟脸色一沉。
楚阳露出一个嘲讽的笑意，就这么静静看着他，眼色有些怪异。
他刚才的话之中第一句“我师尊……”就已经表露了自己的身份，而这个李剑吟居然还问了这么一句。分明是被自己气势所慑，心神已乱。这样的问题，答不答都没有什么意义。
这样的人，更不值得自己重视！
同时心中暗暗警惕，刚才一怒之下，感觉到心中剑气纵.横，眼中无意识的表现了出来。这种情况，以后决不可再有。
楚阳前世，在宗门被灭之后，就离开了天外楼，浪迹天涯。他的性格本就有些孤僻，遭此大变之后，更是桀骜。
除了精修剑法之外，楚阳基本不问外事。一生经历，乏善可陈。也很少与人打交道，一言不合，便即拔剑相向的事情也是常见。久而久之，养成了他的性格便如一柄锋芒毕露的剑一般的孤傲！
黑衣如墨，长剑如雪，纵横天下，莫敢当！
这便是前世的楚阳。但重生之后，楚阳的心态却起了很大的变化，情知自己绝不可能再走前世的路……
而且万事都有弥补的余地，一切遗憾都可以重来。现在的楚阳，正所谓有诗曰：
春风得意马蹄疾，
人逢喜事精神爽；
俱怀逸兴壮思飞，
漫卷诗书喜欲狂！
世界很美好，人生充满了希望，怎么还能孤傲？想孤傲……也孤傲不起来啊。
不过也暗暗警惕，像今天这般心中剑气外泄的情况，最容易引起事端和警惕。以自己现在的微末实力，还是少做为妙。

“你是这紫竹林弟子？”李剑吟见对方不答，不由又问了一句。
楚阳摇摇头，看向那少女。连眼角的余光也不看他。他虽然心境大改，但那种骨子里的孤傲却是根深蒂固。像这种连别人说话都听不明白的家伙，楚阳实在是连看一眼的兴致也欠奉。
李剑吟再次勃然大怒。对方这等毫不掩饰的蔑视，居然激起了他的杀机！
“敢问这位，可是……孟师叔门下，楚阳楚师弟？”少女温婉的笑了笑，轻轻施了一礼。
“在下正是。这位师姐莫非便是聚云峰掌门师伯膝下，乌师姐？”楚阳无所谓的淡然一笑。刚才他一眼就认了出来。
这个姿态娴雅仪态万方的少女，便是天外楼掌门乌云凉之女，乌倩倩。
天外楼第一美女！
也就是前世被石千山欺骗的可怜女子。虽然婚事未成天外楼即全宗尽墨，但总归是一件令人惋惜之事。
“原来真的是楚阳师弟。”乌倩倩温婉的微笑道：“不过楚阳师弟可与传闻之中不一样，刚才险些没敢相认。”
“乌师姐说笑了。”楚阳淡淡的道：“楚阳就是楚阳，并无什么不同。传言有误罢了。”
乌倩倩心中有些奇怪起来。自己身为宗主之女，又是天外楼公认的美人，天外楼的年轻子弟见到自己，无不神魂颠倒，偏偏这楚阳，明明见到了自己，但眼神却如同是看着一个木头一般。
其实楚阳倒不是看不见她的美丽，只不过现在的楚阳全心全意都是莫轻舞，对于莫轻舞的期盼占满了他的心田，连一丝空隙也没有留下。这时候，就算乌倩倩真的是天仙，估计在他眼中也跟木头差不了多少……
乌倩倩虽然也并不喜欢那种被人围绕着天天阿谀奉承的感觉，但彻底被人无视，这却是破天荒第一遭。
再说……听说孟师叔三个弟子，大弟子稳重大方，心机深沉，做事稳妥，乃是栋梁之材。二弟子楚阳孤僻成性，沉默寡言；三弟子谈昙超级的不着调……
但今日一见，这个少年可绝不是‘沉默寡言’的样子啊。虽说多少有些极端，看其脸相，也隐隐有一丝孤傲，但……却绝不是凡俗少年！
李剑吟本来就暗中喜欢乌倩倩，对这位师姐心仪已久。心中不止一次的幻想过能娶这位师姐为妻，不仅佳人如玉，而且还成了掌门女婿……

content_en:
Then he circled around and came back from the outside.
But he didn't expect to see two people standing in front of the Zizhuyuan gate as soon as he came back. And one of them actually made rude remarks and insulted his master! He couldn't help but get angry and retaliate coldly.
As soon as this guy signed up, he knew that this was the only son of Li Jinsong, the master of Suoyun Peak. Therefore, Chu Yang's counterattack is also measured. If you scold my master, I will use your father to retaliate!
Regardless of his past life or this life, Chu Yang would never suffer a loss.
"Who are you?" Li Jianyin, the young man in white, his face darkened.
Chu Yang showed a mocking smile and looked at him quietly with a strange look in his eyes.
The first sentence of what he just said, "My master...", had already revealed his identity, and this Li Jianyin actually asked such a question. He was clearly intimidated by his own momentum and was in a state of confusion. It doesn't matter whether you answer this question or not.
Such people are not worthy of your attention!
At the same time, I was secretly vigilant in my heart. When I was angry just now, I felt the sword energy in my heart was strong and horizontal, and it showed unconsciously in my eyes. This situation must never happen again in the future.
In Chu Yang's previous life, after his sect was destroyed, he left Tianwai Tower and wandered around the world. His character was already somewhat withdrawn, and after this drastic change, he became even more unruly.
Apart from mastering swordsmanship, Chu Yang basically didn't care about foreign affairs. A lifetime of experience is nothing to write home about. He rarely interacts with others, and it is common for him to draw swords against others if they disagree. Over time, he developed a character as aloof and arrogant as a sharp sword!
Black as ink, sword as snow, he dominates the world, no one dares to take it!
This was Chu Yang in his previous life. But after his rebirth, Chu Yang's mentality changed a lot. He knew that he would never follow the path of his previous life again...
And there is room for making up for everything, and all regrets can be repeated. Today's Chu Yang, as the saying goes, has a poem:
The spring breeze is proud of the horse's hooves,
People feel refreshed when happy events happen;
We are all full of joy, strong and thoughtful,
The poems and books are full of joy!
The world is beautiful and life is full of hope. How can we still be aloof and arrogant? Even if I want to be arrogant...I can't be arrogant.
However, I am also secretly vigilant. A situation like today when the sword energy in the heart is leaked is the most likely to cause trouble and vigilance. With my current meager strength, it would be better to do less.
"Are you a disciple of this Purple Bamboo Forest?" Li Jianyin couldn't help but ask again when the other party didn't answer.
Chu Yang shook his head and looked at the girl. Not even looking at him out of the corner of her eye. Although his mood has changed drastically, the aloofness in his bones is still deep-rooted. Chu Yang really didn't even have the interest to take a look at a guy like this who couldn't even understand what others were saying.
Li Jianyin was furious again. The other party's unabashed contempt actually aroused his murderous intention!
"I dare to ask this, but... Junior Brother Chu Yangchu is under Master Meng's sect?" The girl smiled gently and gave a gentle salute.
"That's right. Is this senior sister the disciple of Juyun Peak's master uncle, Senior Sister Wu?" Chu Yang smiled indifferently. He recognized it at a glance just now.
This girl with elegant posture and elegant manners is Wu Qianqian, the daughter of Wu Yunliang, the leader of Tianwai Tower.
The most beautiful woman in Tianwai Tower!
That is, the poor woman who was deceived by Shi Qianshan in her previous life. Although the entire clan was exterminated before the marriage was completed, it is still a regrettable thing.
"It turns out it's really Junior Brother Chu Yang." Wu Qianqian said with a gentle smile: "But Junior Brother Chu Yang is different from the rumors. He almost didn't dare to recognize him just now."
"Senior Sister Wu was joking." Chu Yang said calmly: "Chu Yang is Chu Yang, there is no difference. The rumors are just wrong."
Wu Qianqian felt a little strange in her heart. As the daughter of the sect master and a recognized beauty of Tianwai Tower, the young disciples of Tianwai Tower were all fascinated when they saw her. However, this Chu Yang clearly saw her, but his eyes were as if he were looking at a piece of wood..
In fact, it's not that Chu Yang couldn't see her beauty, but now Chu Yang cared about Mo Qingwu wholeheartedly, and his expectations for Mo Qingwu filled his heart, leaving not even a single gap. At this time, even if Wu Qianqian is really an immortal, she is probably no different from wood in his eyes...
Although Wu Qianqian didn't like the feeling of being surrounded by people and being fawned over every day, it was the first time that she had been completely ignored.
Besides... I heard that of the three disciples of Uncle Meng, the eldest disciple is steady and generous, has a deep scheming mind, and is reliable in doing things. He is a pillar of talent. The second disciple, Chu Yang, is withdrawn and taciturn; the third disciple, Tan Tan, is extremely out of tune...
But when I met him today, I found that this young man was by no means 'taciturn'. Although he is somewhat extreme, and looking at his face, there is a hint of aloofness, but... he is definitely not an ordinary boy!
Li Jianyin secretly liked Wu Qianqian and had been attracted to this senior sister for a long time. More than once, I have fantasized about marrying this senior sister. Not only would she be as beautiful as jade, but she would also become the son-in-law of the head of the clan...
